notes: Closed seasons only. The in-progress season is excluded until it is final.
Results use ESPN official scores (including commissioner adjustments); scoring records use points actually scored.
Playoff appearance = any winners-bracket entry (nearly every team qualifies since 2012). First-round byes are the meaningful measure.
Trades before 2018 are not available from ESPN. 2018+ trades are derived from week-to-week roster movement.

Player points for 2018 were recomputed by ESPN and do not reconcile with team scores; 2018 draft values are flagged ESPN_RESCORED and excluded from draft leaderboards. Before 2017, ESPN's weekly lineups omit some starters, but the player points present are genuine.
Storylines are factual, evidence-backed entries generated from the data; written narratives come after the in-progress season ends.
2007 used a much larger scoring scale; cross-era comparisons use scoring indexes (100 = league average).
